---
name: "🚀 Feature Request / Enhancement"
about: Suggest an idea, UI enhancement, or new functionality
title: "[FEATURE]: "
labels: ["enhancement", "needs-review"]
assignees: ""
---

## 💡 Feature Overview
A clear and concise description of the proposed feature or improvement.

## 🎯 Problem Statement / Motivation
Is this related to a specific problem or friction point? 
> *Example: "It's difficult to track recent TIL entries because..."*

## 🛠️ Proposed Solution
Describe the solution you'd like to see implemented and how it should work.

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## 📋 Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Requirements / UI components outlined
- [ ] Responsive across mobile and desktop
- [ ] Tested locally and in staging/container environment
- [ ] Documentation / TIL updated if applicable

## 📎 Additional Context / Mockups
Add any wireframes, reference links, API design sketches, or screenshots here.
